records.source_statement: If Saturn, Mars or Mercury in specified adverse aspects regards fifth or its lord, Lilly asserts suspicion of other parentage.
limitations: Source's adverse-significator alternative; never treat as conclusive evidence.

records.source_statement: New subsection asks whether an estranged woman will be received back by husband or friend.
limitations: Historical reconciliation question, not relationship-safety guidance.

records.source_statement: When the woman asks, Lilly explicitly makes seventh ruler signify the expelled or banished partner and first ruler the receiving party.
limitations: The direction of concern determines role; do not assign seventh to man by default.

records.source_statement: If seventh lord beholds first house/lord with good aspect, it is called a favourable return or reception sign.
limitations: Relevant lost/expelled person's seventh significator must aspect first.

records.source_statement: Where the seventh ruler does not directly aspect ascendant, another unimpeded planet beholding first may signify mediation by a friend.
limitations: Without direct aspect an intermediary can matter.
